messages:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — Varuna sent their RFP back with an updated ask: capability matrix + final POC schedule + explicit KMS/HSM answers. They want everything by tomorrow 11am PT. Can we lock the answers?

devin_se: On the POC schedule: we can do a 2-week POC with Dedicated GPUs and a short smoke test on Private. Proposed kickoff Mon -> deliver benchmarks day 5, integration week 2. Is that acceptable?

ashley_product: Sounds fine. We'll include a canary rollout plan and rollback criteria. Need to confirm which model variants they'll test (redwood-7b, redwood-14b, quantized 8-bit).

ravi_security: KMS/HSM questions: they want to know whether keys can be customer-managed and whether HSM-backed keys are supported in Private. Short answer: yes for Private and Dedicated with our KMS integration; hosted requires customer KMS federation for full key control — I'll add the precise wording.

maria_sales: @ravi_security great — can you draft the exact RFP wording? They asked: "Does Redwood allow customer-managed keys that never leave customer control?"

ravi_security: Draft: "Customer-managed keys are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Private (VPC or on-prem) customers may use their own HSM or cloud KMS; keys can be configured so that secret material does not transit Redwood control plane. For Hosted API, we support KMS key references via customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) where available, but full HSM custody is only available for Dedicated/Private deployments."

jessica_legal: Add a note about audit logs and key rotation policy: we provide audit logging for key usage and support customer-driven rotation. Will attach standard cryptography appendix.

maria_sales: Thanks. Devin — can you paste a short capability matrix snippet we can attach to the RFP? They asked for feature-level binary table. Keep it concise.

devin_se: Pasting a quick snippet below — we will attach the full CSV separately as rfp_varuna_capability_matrix.csv:

```
Feature,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
Text generation,Yes,Yes,Yes
Streaming responses,Yes,Yes,Yes
Customer-managed KMS,Partial (CMEK),Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional,Optional (on-prem)
Dedicated GPU pools,No,Yes,Yes
SLA-backed latency,No,Yes,Optional

```

maria_sales: Perfect. Also they asked for pricing tiers for the POC and for production. Short bullets: POC — free credits + discounted Dedicated hourly for first 2 weeks; Production — reserved capacity and usage-based hosted pricing. Can we put numbers?

devin_se: POC pricing: apply $10k credit + Dedicated rate at 25% off list for up to 2 weeks (subject to infra availability). Production: reserved capacity pricing requires monthly commit; we typically model at X GPU-hours/month = $Y, plus per-token usage for hosted fallback. I'll send a sanitized example.

ashley_product: Also call out rollout policies: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with automatic fallback to previous model if error rate > 1% or latency above SLO.

maria_sales: @jessica_legal can you confirm any contract language we should avoid in the RFP answer (e.g., sovereignty / indemnities)?

jessica_legal: Avoid promising FedRAMP-level certification unless explicitly selling a Private on-prem product with the right compliance attachments. Recommend language: "Subject to contractual and compliance review; we can support data residency and enterprise controls via Private deployment."

maria_sales: OK final checklist for the RFP response (I'll assemble into one PDF):
- capability matrix CSV (devin)
- KMS/HSM paragraph (ravi)
- POC schedule + discounted pricing (devin)
- rollout & SLO bullets (ashley)
- compliance blurb + appendix (jessica)
- attach our standard SLA and support tiers (ops-bot will attach)

ops-bot: Attached: rfp_sla.pdf, rfp_support_tiers.pdf (uploaded by ops-bot) :white_check_mark:

maria_sales: Thanks team. I'll assemble and send before 10:30am PT to leave margin. Ping here if anything changes. :pray:
